Experience in Your Case Type: Make sure the attorney handles your specific type of claim (e.g., car accident, slip and fall, medical malpractice, or wrongful death). Stephen M. Fuerch +3
Fee Structure: Most personal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis (no upfront fees, and they only get paid if they recover money for you). Anand Desai Law Firm +1
